# Independent Aseprite fixtures

These bytes were downloaded unchanged from [alpine-alpaca/asefile](https://github.com/alpine-alpaca/asefile) at commit [`2274c354cea6764f85597252a0d2228e64709348`](https://github.com/alpine-alpaca/asefile/tree/2274c354cea6764f85597252a0d2228e64709348/tests/data) on 2026-10-16. They were not generated by Pixen. Source paths are `tests/data/<filename>`; `LICENSE` comes from the repository root. The upstream MIT license is retained here.

`basic-16x16.aseprite` is an independently saved RGBA project containing a cropped/offset compressed cel. Its upstream `basic-16x16.png` is the pixel oracle. `linked_cels.aseprite` supplies three RGBA frames with native links, multiple layers, independent cels, and offsets; the three upstream PNG exports are frame pixel oracles.

The remaining native files exercise rejected subsets: grayscale, indexed (`rawcel.aseprite` is indexed despite its name), groups/nesting (`layers_and_tags`), slices, tilemaps, and user data attached to slices (`user_data`). Binary mutation tests use temporary copies and never modify these fixtures.
